title: Add delete button for simulations
description: Allow deleting a simulation from the tile UI (with confirmation). Should remove the simulation record and detach it from the tile, updating local caches and navigating back to /tile/:tileId.

title: On tile zoom: hide dot and place label top-left
description: When viewing a tile route (after zooming into a tile), hide the center dot marker for that tile and render the tile name label at the tile's top-left corner.

title: Support fetching simulation results via simulationId
description: Update Simulation model to include simulationId/resultJson/resultNpz and add UI+API helpers to fetch (and cache) simulation results from /simulate/<simulation_id>.

title: Migrate map viewport to deck.gl
description: Replace MapViewport's direct react-map-gl rendering with DeckGL, using deck layers for tile markers/outlines and keeping existing Mapbox basemap + overlays working.

title: Fix tile dots visibility across zoom/tilt on globe
description: Tile marker dots (and hit area) disappear inconsistently at some zoom levels/tilts on globe projection; ensure markers remain visible/pickable by adjusting deck.gl layer settings (e.g., billboard/pixel units/depth).

title: Map interaction lock not taking effect on tile routes
description: Map still pans/zooms on /tile/:tileId/* despite intended lock; enforce interaction disabling via react-map-gl props.

title: Tile dots invisible when using MapboxDeckOverlay
description: Fix tile dot/outline not rendering when deck layers are interleaved into Mapbox (likely depth-test/depth-buffer interaction).

title: Overlay biomass grid on map via react-map-gl layer
description: Remove biomass grid from side panel and render it as a map overlay using a react-map-gl Layer/Source so it can evolve into more visualization types.

title: Show biomass-over-time chart for simulation runs
description: When a simulation has run data (simulationResultByRecordId), show a new panel with a simple graph of biomass over time (per species and/or total) in the simulation context view.

title: Tile create pane for simulation/plan
description: On /tile/:tileId?create=management-plan or ?create=simulation, show a settings pane (fields + validation) and a Create button that actually creates the record and links it to the tile.

title: Simulation timeline bottom pane
description: When a simulation has run data, show a new bottom pane timeline with play/pause and a scrubber ranging over episode_length steps.

title: Fix deck layers alignment with globe projection
description: Keep Mapbox globe projection enabled, but render deck.gl layers using GlobeView so overlays (tile outline/markers) align with Mapbox image source overlays across globe<->mercator transition.

title: Animate tilt transition when switching to hexagon biomass view
description: Ensure switching biomass visualization to hexagons animates pitch smoothly (no jump) and clears transition props after completion.

title: Biomass overlay: avoid re-decoding base64 on scrub
description: Map biomass canvas overlay was decoding biomass_b64 on every step change. Memoize decoded Float32Array per simulation result and only recompute frame index on step changes.

title: Hexagon tilt transition not animating (DeckGL controller disabled on tile routes)
description: Fix instant pitch change when switching to hexagon view by keeping DeckGL controller enabled (but with interactions disabled) so transitionDuration/FlyToInterpolator are applied.

title: Hover landcover image overlay misaligned when zoomed out (globe projection)
description: Fix tile image overlay alignment when map is in globe projection by forcing mercator projection in simulation routes (deck.gl overlays assume WebMercator).

title: Zoom into tile on route navigation
description: When navigating to a tile-specific route, automatically zoom/pan the view to that tile.

title: Add map biomass visualization dropdown (ScreenGrid vs Hexagon)
description: Add a UI dropdown on the map to choose biomass visualization type (ScreenGridLayer vs H3HexagonLayer) and render the selected deck.gl layer.

title: Nested tile simulation/plan routes
description: Add nested routes /tile/:tileId/simulation/:id and /tile/:tileId/management-plan/:id, and make simulation/plan cards navigate there.

title: Tile view: move back+tile info to right pane
description: On /tile/:id with no selection, right pane should show the same tile info as before (and a Back button). Left pane should only contain simulations/plans list + create, without tile info/back.

title: Render tile markers (dots/outline/labels) as Mapbox layers
description: Deck.gl ScatterplotLayer-based tile dots/outline still vanish at some zoom/tilt angles on globe. Move tile markers to native Mapbox GL layers (circle/line/symbol) so they render consistently on the globe.

title: Refreshing /tile/:id shows error again
description: Reloading on /tile/:tileId now triggers a client error/overlay again. Likely due to unhandled promise rejection from asset fetch; make asset fetches non-throwing or catch errors.

title: Move plans/sims list + create to tile left pane
description: Change layout: Map tile selection shows only a 'Select tile' button that navigates to /tile/:id. On /tile/:id, show zoom + contextual right pane (no selection by default) and a left pane listing simulations/plans for the tile with create options; selecting updates the right pane via nested routes.

title: Lock map panning/zooming on tile routes
description: Disable map interactions (pan/zoom/rotate) when route matches /tile/:tileId or any subroute, so the map is fixed while working in tile context.

title: Tile page missing landcover/ocean details
description: Regression: /tile/:id no longer shows the landcover/ocean data sections (previews/coverage) that existed in the tile details panel.

title: Management-plans page retries forever on error
description: Auto-refresh useEffect re-triggers when list fetch fails (plans stays null), causing repeated requests / apparent infinite loading. Guard auto-refresh on error (and use !== null checks).

title: Force MapboxOverlay remount when interleaved changes
description: MapboxOverlay's interleaved flag is only read in the constructor; changing the prop later doesn't switch modes. Ensure the overlay control remounts (new instance) so interleaved=true actually applies, fixing globe pitch alignment for H3 layer.

title: Tile hover image overlay still misaligned when zoomed out
description: Image overlay (Mapbox image source) drifts from the tile bounds when zoomed out. Force mercator projection consistently (Mapbox + deck) and verify overlay coordinate assumptions.

title: Tile dots still not visible at low zoom
description: Ensure tile dots remain visible at low zoom by enforcing pixel sizing via radiusMinPixels and lineWidthMinPixels (globe + MapboxOverlay).

title: Biomass grid display + shared simulation timeline state
description: Visualize per-cell biomass snapshots by coloring a grid (argmax species + intensity). Refactor simulation-timeline to use shared Jotai atoms (step/playing) in a new simulation UI state file, and have the biomass grid use the same state.

title: Tile route zoom sometimes throws 'Style is not done loading'
description: On /tile/:tileId (often after refresh), app hits ErrorBoundary with 'Style is not done loading'. Likely from fitBounds/flyTo before map style is ready; make zoom effect retry on idle and never throw.

title: Refreshing /tile/:tileId shows white screen
description: Reloading the app on a tile route causes a runtime error / blank screen. Make tile route resilient on cold start and avoid unhandled async errors.

title: Biomass overlay orientation incorrect
description: Biomass canvas overlay is misaligned; rotate 90° left and flip vertically (data axis transform) so pixels align with tile coordinates.

title: Tile overview should retain sims/plans after back
description: After viewing /tile/:tileId/(simulation|management-plan)/:id and returning to /tile/:tileId, the tile pane should still show the tile's simulations/plans so context isn't lost.

title: Tile-only submenu with animation
description: Only show the TopNav secondary submenu when on /tile/:tileId, and animate it in/out on route changes.

title: Simulation create: agent dropdown
description: When creating a simulation, show available agents (from /simulate/agents) in a dropdown. Persist selection on the simulation record (via options) and use it when fetching results.

title: Tilt transition snaps instantly because effect re-triggers during transition
description: Fix pitch animation snapping by ensuring the tilt effect doesn't restart the transition on every intermediate pitch update.

title: Context pane only on nested simulation/plan routes
description: When on /tile/:tileId/simulation/:id or /tile/:tileId/management-plan/:id, the right pane should only show the relevant context (simulation or plan) and hide create/new options.

title: Align tile markers/outlines with globe by rendering deck layers via MapboxOverlay
description: Tile outline and marker dot (deck layers) drift in globe projection. Render deck.gl layers using @deck.gl/mapbox MapboxOverlay so they use Mapbox's globe matrices and align with Mapbox image sources.

title: Management plan + simulation pages list all
description: Make /simulations and /management-plans pages list all available simulations/plans (not tile-scoped), using existing PocketBase/Jotai state.

title: Try non-interleaved MapboxOverlay for stable marker visibility
description: Deck marker dots still disappear at some zoom/tilt angles on globe even with billboard=true; try MapboxOverlay non-interleaved (separate canvas) to avoid Mapbox depth/state occlusion.

title: Tilt map when hexagon biomass visualization selected
description: When user selects the H3 hexagon biomass visualization, animate the DeckGL viewState pitch (tilt) to a 3D angle; reset back when leaving hex view.

title: Run simulation via /simulation/:recordId/run
description: Replace simulationId+Fetch data UI with a single Run simulation button that calls GET /simulation/<simulation_record_id>/run (upload+run+cache). Update API helper + atoms accordingly.

title: Fix H3 hex layer alignment/pitch on globe
description: On globe, H3HexagonLayer appears detached/tilted differently than the map (looks like it floats). Use MapboxOverlay interleaved mode so deck layers render as Mapbox custom layers and stay aligned with globe pitch/bearing, and ensure ordering under tile markers.

title: Refactor deck map layers into src/map-layers and switch biomass overlay to ScreenGridLayer
description: Create src/map-layers, move deck.gl layer construction out of MapViewport, and replace biomass canvas/raster overlay with a deck.gl ScreenGridLayer.

title: Reloading on simulation route should fetch existing simulation results
description: On hard reload or direct navigation to /tile/:tileId/simulation/:simulationId, hydrate simulationResultByRecordIdAtom by loading the cached resultJson for that simulation record (without re-running the simulation).
